intro.heading: I enjoy sharing the joys of design in real projects.

topics.title: Design in financial services
topics.body: How design can shape delivery direction by creating shared understanding across product, operations, and technical stakeholders.

topics.title: Practical design thinking and storytelling
topics.body: How cross-functional teams can use storyboard methods and design thinking with AI to turn ideas into testable concepts and clearer decisions.

talks.title: The Design Thinking BA powered by AI
talks.description: How design thinking and AI can support business analysts in insight generation, requirement shaping, and rapid prototyping for clearer delivery conversations.

talks.title: Storyboard: Bring Your Product/Service Concept to Life
talks.description: A Skillshare class on using storyboarding to make product and service ideas easier to understand, communicate, and test.

talks.title: Research with complex user groups
talks.description: Practical advice on planning and running research with hard-to-reach user groups, so teams can learn enough to make confident decisions without pretending access is easy.

workshopsIntro: I run sessions that give teams practical tools, sharper alignment, and more clarity on messy problems.
workshopFormats: Workshops on journey mapping, service blueprinting, and decision-focused problem framing
Team sessions for cross-functional facilitation in complex delivery environments
beyondWork: Outside client delivery, I enjoy mentoring and contributing to the design community through talks, workshops, and shared learning sessions.
I also host bilingual events in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin, including wedding master of ceremony engagements.

opportunitiesText: If you are running a session, event, or workshop and want something practical, grounded, and based on real delivery work, I would be glad to collaborate.
